summary: Russia launched a massive combined overnight strike on Ukraine using two Iskander-M ballistic missiles and 94 Shahed-type UAVs, hitting Kyiv, Kharkiv, and Odesa with casualties (Source: @kpszsu/67858). Ukrainian air defenses intercepted 72 UAVs but recorded 19 UAV and two missile impacts across 13 locations (Source: @kpszsu/67858). Simultaneously, Ukrainian drones struck Russian oil refineries in Saratov, Tatarstan, Bashkortostan, and Stavropol regions (Source: @UkraineNow/82519, @eRadarrua/100407).
key_points: Russian forces fired two Iskander-M ballistic missiles from occupied Crimea and 94 strike UAVs from multiple directions overnight July 8-9 (Source: @kpszsu/67858).
Ukrainian air defense shot down or suppressed 72 enemy UAVs across northern, southern, and eastern Ukraine (Source: @kpszsu/67858).
Two ballistic missiles and 19 strike UAVs hit 13 locations; debris fell on four additional sites (Source: @kpszsu/67858).
Kyiv suffered one killed and six wounded from UAV attacks; Desnyansky district gas station hit (Source: @UkraineNow/82511, @UkraineNow/82498).
Odesa attack killed two people, damaged infrastructure, and wounded two (Source: @UkraineNow/82518).
Ukrainian drones hit Nizhnekamskneftekhim plant in Tatarstan, Saratov refinery (one killed), and Rosneft Stavropol oil base (Source: @UkraineNow/82519, @eRadarrua/100407).
US to provide Ukraine license to produce Patriot missiles; Trump stated Ukraine can manufacture them independently (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31477, @eRadarrua/100359).
US intelligence warns of massive combined strike on Ukraine within 72 hours targeting Nova Poshta warehouses, factories, and other depots (Source: @mon1tor_ua/68818).

sections.executive_summary: Russia executed a large-scale combined air attack overnight July 8-9, launching two Iskander-M ballistic missiles from occupied Crimea and 94 Shahed, Gerber, Irtysh, and Parody UAVs from Bryansk, Millerovo, Orel, Gvardeyskoye, and occupied Donetsk (Source: @kpszsu/67858). Ukrainian defenses intercepted 72 UAVs but confirmed 19 UAV and two missile strikes on 13 locations across northern, southern, and eastern Ukraine, with casualties in Kyiv (1 killed, 6 wounded) and Odesa (2 killed, 2 wounded) (Source: @kpszsu/67858, @UkraineNow/82511, @UkraineNow/82518). Concurrently, Ukrainian long-range drones struck Russian energy infrastructure in Tatarstan, Saratov, Bashkortostan, and Stavropol, hitting refineries and an oil base (Source: @UkraineNow/82519, @eRadarrua/100407).

points: Ukrainian air defense forces shot down or suppressed 72 Russian UAVs (Shahed, Gerber, Irtysh, Parody) across northern, southern, and eastern Ukraine during the overnight July 8-9 attack (Source: @kpszsu/67858).

Ukraine will receive up to 30 Patriot missiles from the US, Europe, and Japan within a week, sufficient to intercept up to 15 ballistic missiles — roughly one incomplete Russian mass attack on Kyiv (Source: @mon1tor_ua/68819).

Ukrainian drones conducted long-range strikes on Russian oil infrastructure: Nizhnekamskneftekhim plant in Tatarstan, Saratov refinery (one fatality), and Rosneft Stavropol oil base in the Stavropol region (Source: @UkraineNow/82519, @eRadarrua/100407).

Zelensky and Trump held a joint press conference at the NATO summit in Ankara; Trump pledged a license for Ukraine to produce Patriot missiles independently and called strikes on Russian refineries an escalation that could end the conflict (Source: @UkraineNow/82509, @UkraineNow/82519).

Kyiv air defense engaged multiple waves of jet-powered Shahed UAVs passing near Desna, Lyubychi, Drabiv, and Irpin; debris hit a gas distribution station in Desnyansky district (Source: @mon1tor_ua/68809, @mon1tor_ua/68800, @eRadarrua/100368, @UkraineNow/82498).
US intelligence community warned of a massive combined Russian strike on Ukraine within 72 hours targeting Nova Poshta warehouses, factories, and other logistics depots (Source: @mon1tor_ua/68818).
Ukrainian forces shot down a Russian Su-35 multirole fighter on the eastern front, per the July 8 morning summary (Source: @UkraineNow/82519).

Russian forces launched two Iskander-M ballistic missiles from occupied Crimea and 94 strike UAVs (including jet-powered Shaheds, Gerber, Irtysh, Parody) from Bryansk, Millerovo, Orel, Gvardeyskoye (Crimea), and occupied Donetsk overnight July 8-9 (Source: @kpszsu/67858).
Russian "South" grouping destroyed a Ukrainian ground robotic complex near Konstantinovka, per Russian MoD video (Source: @tass_agency/384469).

Russian troops advanced up to 800 meters in twelve sectors on the Volchansk direction, with small-arms battles in Yurchenkovo, Bely Kolodez, and Volchansk district forest areas (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31467).
Russian offensive operations continue in Kazachya Lopan (Kharkiv direction) and Kupyansk urban areas, where Russian forces are expanding control (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31467).

Russian drone attacks on Belgorod region wounded multiple civilians: FPV drone hit a bus in Tavrovo (2 injured), strike on commercial facility (3 injured), GAZ vehicle near Tomarovka (driver wounded), and civilian in Novy Oskol (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31467).
Russian strikes hit Kharkiv and Odesa on July 8, causing casualties; Kharkiv attacked with KAB guided bombs (Source: @kpszsu/67869, @UkraineNow/82519).
Russian air defense shot down Ukrainian UAVs on approach to Moscow and over Crimea, where civilian objects were also targeted (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31467).
On the Dobropolye direction, Russian forces are intensifying pressure on approaches to the city; fighting ongoing for Sergeyevka (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31467).
On the Slavyansk direction, Russian forces are leveling the front for an advance toward Nikolayevka; fighting in villages on the approach to Kramatorsk (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31467).
In the Dnipropetrovsk region, Russian AG "East" units destroyed enemy forces and occupied strongholds in the Alexandrovka and Bogodarovka area (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31467).

In the eastern Zaporizhzhia region, Russian AG "East" continued dismantling Ukrainian defenses west of Lesnoye, capturing strongholds and eliminating small infiltration groups (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31467).
Russian KAB guided bomb launches reported on northern Kharkiv region and Donbas (Donetsk region) (Source: @kpszsu/67869).
Ukrainian forces continue to throw equipment and infantry into the Alexandrovka-Bogodarovka area attempting to slow Russian assault units (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31467).
Dneprorudnoye (Zaporizhzhia region) under Ukrainian strikes; artillery shelling in Kamensko-Dneprovsky district damaged gas supply lines (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31467).

On the Sumy direction, Russian AG "North" continues small-arms battles in Bachevsk, Ulanovo area, Ryzhevka, Pisarevka, Marino, Novaya Sich, Khoten, and forest areas south of Ivolzhanskoye (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31467).
In the Krasnopolye district (Sumy region), small-arms battles continue in forest areas (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31467).
On the Kharkiv direction, Russian AG "North" continues offensive operations in Kazachya Lopan settlement (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31467).
On the Volchansk direction, Russian forces advanced up to 800 meters in twelve sectors; battles in Yurchenkovo, Bely Kolodez, and Volchansk district forests (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31467).
On the Velikoburluk direction, small-arms battles in Petro-Ivanovka and forest areas near Shevyakovka, Budarki, Zemlyanki (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31467).
Russian drone attack in Kursk region hit a vehicle in Selektsionny (Lgov district), wounding the driver (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31467).
Multiple Ukrainian drone strikes in Belgorod region wounded civilians and damaged infrastructure; bridges destroyed in border villages Shelayevo and Urazovo (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31467).
Russian attack on Odesa killed two people, damaged infrastructure, and wounded two (Source: @UkraineNow/82518).
In the Kherson region, mortar shelling in Cossack Camps (Aleshkinsky Municipal District) injured a woman and a man; numerous villages struck, power supply disrupted (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31467).
Zaporizhzhia region: Dneprorudnoye under Ukrainian strikes; gas supply damaged in Kamensko-Dneprovsky district (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31467).
Russian "South" grouping destroyed a Ukrainian ground robotic complex near Konstantinovka (Donetsk region) (Source: @tass_agency/384469).
Ukrainian drones struck Russian oil infrastructure in Stavropol region (Rosneft oil base) and Saratov region (refinery) (Source: @eRadarrua/100407, @UkraineNow/82519).
Russian KAB guided bomb launches reported on Donbas (Donetsk region) (Source: @kpszsu/67869).
Ukrainian long-range drones reached Saratov, Voronezh, Tatarstan, and Bashkortostan, attacking several refineries (Source: @UkraineNow/82519).

sections.threat_assessment: The overnight combined strike demonstrates Russia's capacity to sustain large-scale missile-UAV barrages while Ukraine's air defense, though effective at interception (72/94 UAVs), still suffers significant penetration (19 UAVs + 2 ballistic missiles). The simultaneous Ukrainian deep strikes on Russian refineries across four regions signal a deliberate campaign to degrade Russian energy revenue and military logistics. The US warning of another massive strike within 72 hours targeting logistics hubs suggests Russia may be preparing a follow-on operation to disrupt Ukrainian supply chains. The limited Patriot missile supply (30 interceptors) covers only a fraction of a single Russian mass attack, highlighting a critical air defense shortage. Trump's pledge for Patriot production licensing could alleviate this long-term but offers no immediate relief.
